ja: 2012年、ＢＢ戦士 生誕25周年！　懐かしいあのアイテムが、今、甦る！！
超盛りだくさんな限定スペシャルセットだ！　'80年代、一世を風靡したＢＢ戦士達がスペシャル仕様になって登場！
歴代の指導員達が人気のＢＢ戦士をセレクト。
激レアなサイコガンダムや、今や幻の“３種の神器”復刻！！
「本体カラーは限定カラー！」
「新規ホイルシール採用！」
「“３種の神器”付属！」
「ＢＢ戦士オリジナルカードダス ３枚付属！」

• 「３種の神器」〈パールホワイト成形〉
天翔の神器／麒麟の神器／青龍の神器

en: 2012, 25th birthday of BB Senshi! That nostalgic item is now revived! !
This is a super limited special set! The BB warriors who were all the rage in the '80s are now available in special editions!
Past instructors have selected popular BB warriors.
The extremely rare Psycho Gundam and the now-mythical "Three Sacred Treasures" have been reprinted! !
"The main body color is a limited edition color!"
"New foil Seal adopted!"
"Includes 3 types of sacred treasures!"
"BB Senshi original Carddass 3 pieces included!"
Set contents
• Musha Gundam Metallic Ver. <Gloss injection, extra finish (silver)>
• Nomaru Gundam Metallic Ver. <Gloss injection, extra finish (silver)>
• Zakuto Clear Ver.
• Musyasaiko Gundam 2012 Ver. <Metallic molding>
• "Three kinds of sacred treasures" <Pearl white molding>
Tensho's Sacred Treasure/Kirin's Sacred Treasure/Seiryu's Sacred Treasure
• 3 original Carddass
*"Dark Shogun" parts are not included in "Sakoutou Clear Ver."
*Due to production reasons, some parts of "Giant Saiko" are included in "Musha Psycho Gundam 2012 Ver."
